轮回画风关键提示词全套整理如下，可直接喂给 ComfyUI/SD。

---

## 一、基准风格词（每张图必加在最前面）

```
masterpiece, best quality, ultra-detailed, 8k, digital painting, concept art, dark fantasy, Chinese mythology style, impasto thick brushstrokes, ink wash splatter, high contrast, dramatic chiaroscuro, dark palette, cinematic lighting, rim lighting, volumetric fog, floating debris, epic and oppressive atmosphere
```

## 二、通用反向词

```
lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, words, letters, chinese characters, calligraphy, writing, caption, subtitle, error, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, logo, username, artist name, seal, stamp, label, blurry, bright cheerful colors, cute, chibi, photorealistic, 3d render
```

> 强制规则：画面禁止出现任何文字、水印、签名、印章、Logo，正向词里也不要加文字描述。

---

## 三、画风提示词（按需叠加）

| 类别 | 选项 | 关键词 |
|---|---|---|
| **笔触质感** | 厚涂 | `impasto thick brushstrokes, visible brushstrokes` |
| | 水墨 | `ink wash splatter, Chinese ink painting, splash ink, flying white` |
| | 泼溅 | `splatter paint, ink splashes, dynamic brush marks` |
| | 油画感 | `oil painting texture, canvas texture` |
| **流派风格** | 暗黑幻想 | `dark fantasy, concept art, wlop style` |
| | 东方仙侠 | `Chinese mythology style, wuxia, xianxia aesthetic` |
| | 末世都市 | `dark urban fantasy, ruined city` |
| | 神魔 | `demonic aesthetic, divine horror, deity and monster` |
| **光影氛围** | 高对比 | `high contrast, dramatic chiaroscuro` |
| | 电影感 | `cinematic lighting, rim lighting, volumetric fog` |
| | 体积光 | `volumetric light rays, god rays through mist` |
| | 压迫感 | `oppressive atmosphere, epic scale, floating debris` |

## 四、主色调可选词

- **黑红**：`black and crimson palette, blood-red accents, red and black ink`
- **黑金**：`black and gold palette, golden accents, divine golden glow`
- **冰蓝**：`electric blue glow, icy blue water, teal shadows`
- **银白**：`silver and black palette, metallic silver scales, cold reflections`
- **单色**：`monochrome black and white, grayscale, ink wash monochrome`

---

## 五、5 类构图模板

**① 小人物 vs 巨物**（压迫/神圣/宿命）
```
extreme wide shot, tiny figure in foreground, colossal [异象] towering above, low angle looking up, vast scale difference, dramatic scale contrast
```
人物在画面下 1/3 很小，巨物占上半 2/3，仰视。

**② 中心对称 / 中轴王座**（庄严/帝王）
```
centered composition, symmetrical framing, character sitting on throne facing viewer, frontal view, subject at center, mirror elements on left and right, imposing and regal
```
人物居中正面，左右镜像元素（龙/烟雾/柱子），主体垂直顶满。

**③ 对角线 / S 形动势**（速度/战斗张力）
```
diagonal composition, dynamic action pose, S-curve leading line, motion blur along diagonal, swirling brushstrokes, body twisting from lower-left to upper-right
```
人物沿对角线扭转，武器/水流/龙身沿同线劈出，飞溅笔触顺动势方向。

**④ 背影 / 剪影凝视**（代入/孤寂/未知）
```
over-the-shoulder shot, back view, silhouette character looking at [异象] in distance, viewer POV, vast landscape, character smaller than environment, contemplative mood
```
人物背对观众占一侧，视线方向留大片空景给异象。

**⑤ 群像对峙**（冲突/叙事）
```
three-point composition, multiple figures facing off, central character as apex, opposing figures on left and right, triangular arrangement, tense standoff, epic ensemble shot
```
中间人物为三角顶点，左右各一个对立角色，视线交汇，背景统一光源。

---

**拼装公式**：基准风格词 + 主体描述 + 构图模板关键词 + 主色调 + 背景。
